assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide website hero artwork for Aura Genesis Observer Studio, an ambitious personal intelligence and reflective learning system. Create an original cinematic, richly textured cut-open geode floating just above an island shoreline at blue hour. Within the mineral cavity are three distinct nested translucent viewing shells, luminous cyan, amethyst, and soft amber, each revealing a different scale: environmental patterns, an attentive inner aperture, and a reflective echo. The setting evokes subtropical sand, sea and open sky, without claiming a real photographed location. Elegant scientific-art sensibility, substantial mineral texture, deep midnight blue, violet and warm amber details, luminous but restrained. Main geode slightly right of centre so a website can place copy beside it. Landscape 16:9 composition. No text, letters, numerals, logos, diagrams or watermark. This is conceptual illustration, not a real photograph.
assets.promptBrief: Original cinematic cut-open geode above a subtropical shoreline at blue hour, three translucent viewing shells in cyan, amethyst and amber, mineral texture, environmental patterns and reflective apertures, no text or claim of a photographed real place.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: second wide editorial hero illustration for an ambitious Aura personal-intelligence and teacher-training workshop website.
